title: Add startup idle and peak resource measurement
description: Measure standalone startup readiness, idle RSS/CPU, peak RSS, and shutdown behavior under the low-resource contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Measurement captures time to first successful health/readiness, idle RSS/CPU, peak RSS/CPU, and shutdown duration
The test distinguishes build-time resource use from runtime resource use
Repeated runs do not show unbounded growth within the agreed window or leak child processes/listeners
Results include host and artifact metadata and are comparable before/after

steps.details: Create a synthetic resource sample and test aggregation for missing/negative/invalid samples before implementation.
Use OS/process metrics and bounded sampling intervals; avoid adding a permanent high-frequency timer to production.
Run the staged server with a temporary DB, record readiness/shutdown, and inspect child processes/listeners for leaks.
Store sanitized baseline/candidate results under `.agent/evidence/` and state whether a real VPS run is still required.

technicalNotes: Peak RSS is a measurement, not a hard-coded promise; record the host and sampling interval with every result.
